notes.title: UpGun technical changes 2.0.6.1
notes.notes:
Hey !
Thank you all for the reception of the last update !

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1575870/view/4182233734644275405

UpGun peaked with [b]220 concurrent players[/b] last week end.

Since I did a lot of work in the last update some issues appeared and were fixed :
[list]
[*] The sensibility wasn't correct when controlling a drone.
[*] The sensibility wasn't set for the first 0.2s after spawning.
[/list]
[u]This was fixed the very next day[/u] on the beta branch. I took a lot of time to rewrite the save system in cpp in order to access it from the base classes of the game code.

Since I rewrote the save, your settings have been reset.

I took some time to also add a very requested feature, deck renaming.
If you play with decks, you can now rename your decks to easily find them.

Other changes :
- Fixed an issue where some players could not access mutators.
- Updated the spoutnik collision.

notes.title: New update ! UpGun goes to space !
notes.notes:
Hey !
Long time no see, I had a lot of work on another project (Blood Rush) that required most of my time that past year, but things on cooling down and I was able to cook again for UpGun. So I'm back with a new update with new content!

New content like,
[h1]A brand new map ![/h1]
Discover the [i][b]USS[/b][/i], the UpGun Space Station!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/e7fe045742b3e496d4417945341a2b44e7f37744.png[/img]
The gravity feels lower somehow, but still, be careful to no fall off to the moon.
This is best played with 3-4 players.

[h1]New mutators ![/h1]
This update instead of new upgrades introduces 3 new mutators to spice up your games!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/ab96c22b4341cc73b604d2138c25ca858978e713.png[/img]
[list]
[*][h2]Low gravity (available in the free version)[/h2]
Bring the low gravity from the new Space Station map to the old ones to revisit them!

[*][h2]Grenade spawner[/h2]
You can now turn yourself into a living grenade spawner and spawn a new grenade at your location every 5 secondes!
And obviously these grenades inherit your grenade upgrades.

[*][h2]Only knife[/h2] (by popular demand!)
Take the Gun out of UpGun, and you can only fight your friends with your screw driver.
[/list]


[h2]New cosmetics ![/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/56420c46f43995b2f4a8b6dae9df48c2fa4519fd.png[/img]
New cosmetics are available to drop !

I also made some changes to the game, here is the
[h2]Changelog :[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated the spawn algorythm.
[*] The sensitivity settings affects the controller now. (you might need to reconfigure your sensitivity)
[*] Faster piercing bullets will pierce thicker walls.
[*] Added a trail behind grenades, the trail will adapt to the team color.
[*] Buffed the Pointy Knife upgrade to deal 888 damage on max level.
[*] Added a small Valentine's day seasonnal event.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes :[/h3]
- Fixed an issue when the homing bullets markers showed up in the top left corner of the screen.
- Fixed a typo on the BSOD cosmetic screen (thanks to ZNS for the fixed texture)
- Updated Oil Rig's icon to reflect the finished map design
- Fixed a hole in a ceiling in Oil rig.
- Fixed motion blur option not being saved properly
- Optimized the particle systems
- Added the seasonnal events to Arcadium.
- The team names are now translated in various languages.
- Fixed "WaterCooling" not being really effective.
- Remade all the footsteps code with Easy Foot Step. (my plugin)
- misc fixes

I really hope you like this update ! Another one is coming this summer with a new map, new skills and gifts !

Max'

notes.title: UpGun the Arcadium Update
notes.notes:
[h2]Welcome to the [b]arcadium update[/b] ![/h2]

This year was full of projects for UpGun, and i'm finally glad to present to you what we've been working on lately both ingame and IRL !
This summer we are planning to add a lot of features et new content to UpGun and it starts today ! We release today a brand new map, decks, new skills, 
Two more updates are planned to come out soon !

[h1][b]New map[/b][/h1]
Discover our new arena "Arcadium" a real playground filled with arcades, an escape room and a laser game !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/8b207b044b3c281ff9d65a91e046d3d4055447c7.gif[/img]

Face your friends in the tense laser game room and leave on top ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/65900a5c3b76f8fd878ef5812b1695cc5830b065.png[/img]

I recommend to play with 4 players on this map as you can easily get lost in the laser labyrinth.

[h1][b]New Skills[/b][/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/34fe94e68d6a754df292cdc1dabbd0b263dd664b.png[/img]

Try out new skills to surprise your friends !
[list]
[*] [b]Reflected laser[/b] : 
Upgrade your laser to reflect it on surfaces and hit hidden targets !
[*] [b]Piercing laser[/b] : 
Your laser can now hit multiple targets at once, each target multiplies the total damage.
[*] [b][COMPROMISE] Maximum Switfness[/b] : 
Run really fast ! (but slow down is you get hit)
[*] [b]Long slide[/b] : 
Slide, but longer.
[*] [b]Controlled explosion specialist[/b] : 
Your controlled explosion deals 50% less damage to yourself !
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/628250b3a4301917dd3d6c19b16481ddca22f9cd.png[/img]

[h1][b]New limited merch[/b][/h1]
UpGun finally gets unique merch ! 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/fed3cf9ec77d9843384c5734c360742597056b59.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Get this limited edition plush this [b]now[/b] on [url=https://www.makeship.com/products/kat-0-dik ]MakeShip[/url]
[/list]


[h1]New deck system[/h1]
UpGun (the full version) now has more than 80 unique upgrades. We get that it can be hard to get what you want each round but it is part of the fun ! However, we listened and added a new alternative playstyle using decks.

Play with your friends and a limited deck you chose !
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/a748f75d62bf7c26d3994531d436d7be3397b434.png[/img]
[i]Create a deck from the main menu and select one from the lobby menu ![/i]

[h1]New stuff[/h1]

-Added decks to gamemodes
-Added a new animation to inspect your knife
-Added a delay and a progress bar on the lobby button to start a game
-Changed laser visuals
-New achievements
[b]-Added new secrets promo codes[/b]
-New spawn animation

-Optimized UI
-Optimized particle pooling
-More optimizations
-New spawn points on Farm
-Added better air control when dead
-Increased default skills limit to 7 (was 5)
-Increased banned skills limit to 15 (was 10)
-Improved scoreboard
-Improved controller compatibility
-Added partial spanish translation

[h2]New skins[/h2]
Each Update comes with some new skins to customize your character, today we're adding 10 new skins, here they are :
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/54b8106bedb44fe5e22587b31a1dd5dc756a9d01.png[/img]
Some of them are available to buy on Steam but you always can drop these ones by playing (also on the free version)


[h2]Balance changes[/h2]

-Buffed default grenades
-Buffed laser damage
-Nerfed Instant grenade
-Buffed anti gravity grenade
-Buffed Jump boost (+40%)
-Buffed magazine size damage bonus for thrown magazines.
-Added a level to jump boost (max level is now 3) 
-Nerfed Auto repair
-"Reset" now gives back a throwing knife

[h3]Bug fixes :[/h3]

-Corrected animation delay on Lasers, grenade launchers and shotguns
-Fixed grenade launcher fire sound spacialisation
-Fixed shrapnel kills not giving points.
-Fixed knife weight painting
-Fixed typo in credits

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40485881/0762fda53c2ed99b95f930e83d5fe969aa054b4e.gif[/img]
Thanks Jalal for the animated gif !

New version is 2.0.4.0 !
Max'

notes.title: UpGun 1.1.3 (Patch note 3)
notes.notes:
Third patch !
This is probably the last of the daily patches since the game is running very well !
Now we'll start to focus on producing new content!

-Rounds will now end correctly even when a player quits in the middle of a game.
-The "??" will be less frequent in server names.
-Spam crouch to climb unwalkable areas is a thing of the past.
-Added some icons for bindings.
-Exploit on game settings fixed.
-Server names are displayed correctly again.
-Fixed a bug where you could not start the game when everyone was ready sometimes.
-Some sound effects were playing when they should not be in the lobby.
-Server names are now limited in length.
-Bullets did not bounce in the Everstopped offices.

notes.title: UpGun patch 1.1.1
notes.notes:
Second patchnote !

Less consequent this time, there are less issues than the first day!

-Addition of 5 new cosmetics !

-You can no longer gain life by shooting lamps or some objects.
-The main menu could appear on the customization menu.
-The inventory in the game is updated more regularly.
-Some games crashed at launch. 
-The shotgun aims better.
-Shotgun particles now work in all clients!
-The frequency of cosmetic drops has been changed.
-Some images were not good.
-The "electrocardiogram" screen was considered as a hat.
-Added error messages.

Fixed multiple OOBs

Translated with www.DeepL.com/Translator (free version)

notes.title: Day one patch
notes.notes:
Hello ! 
The game has just been released and we are very happy to see that you really like it! Your feedback is really cool!

On top of that, you found a lot of little problems with the game, and that's normal it's just been released and we're a very small team!

So we've been working hard to give you a better experience!

We also noticed that some of you were frustrated playing in public servers when the game is more oriented towards playing with friends. That's why there's an addition in this patch.

Change:
-Added a list of friends connected to UpGun in the Lobby to more easily invite your Steam friends.
-Removed the "Join Game" button because people thought it was matchmaking and found it frustrating.
-Added more error messages when logging out.
-Added a border for the spectator HUD.


Bugs fixed:
-Fixed a bug on the audio of the hangar doors
-Mouse sensitivity is also applied to ghosts now !
-The back button is back (on the password menu)
-Spectators will no longer be able to escape from the cards!
-The spectator could not move sometimes
-The spectators have the same sensitivity as the player.
-The spectators have a set of keys modelled on the player's.
-Fixed several Out Of Bounds feats
-Fixed a possible soft lock with the weapon extensions.
-Fixed a bug in the animation of weapon extensions.
_Cheat vulnerability patched.
-Persistent tooltips will not happen anymore!


Some typos have been fixed too!
